description: This file defines the interface MergedShuffleFileManager for managing push-based shuffle operations in Apache Spark, including methods for handling shuffle data streams, finalizing merges, registering executors, retrieving merged data and metadata, and cleanup.

methods.name: receiveBlockDataAsStream
methods.description: Provides a callback to process a remotely pushed shuffle block stream.

methods.name: finalizeShuffleMerge
methods.description: Finalizes the shuffle merge for a given shuffle, returning merge statuses.

methods.name: registerExecutor
methods.description: Registers an executor with the shuffle file manager, providing storage directories.

methods.name: applicationRemoved
methods.description: Cleans up metadata and optionally deletes directories when an application finishes.

methods.name: getMergedBlockData
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer for a specific merged shuffle chunk.

methods.name: getMergedBlockMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a merged shuffle block.

methods.name: getMergedBlockDirs
methods.description: Returns directories storing merged shuffle files for an application.

methods.name: removeShuffleMerge
methods.description: Removes shuffle merge data files based on provided shuffle details.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes resources associated with the shuffle file manager.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns metrics related to the shuffle file manager.
